title: Delete The Worker Route (One Action Fix)
style: tech rap, edge networking flow, 95 bpm, gritty 808, sidechained pad, terminal voice, cloudflare core, debugging anthem, deadpan precision
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Worker route in the Cloudflare lane
Serving generic template same name
DNS swap won't bypass the worker
Runs before the origin lookup quirker

[Pre-Chorus]
Constructor Vargas origin shipped seven four eight eight bytes
Real content waiting behind the edge lights

[Chorus]
Delete the worker route delete the worker route
That's the one action to flip the doubt
Site fourteen waiting at the gate
Operator dashboard one click fate

[Verse 2]
Pelican was Pages CNAME swap won the day
Vargas is Workers different way
Workers run before origin runs
That's why the swap didn't change the funs

[Bridge]
CF Dashboard Workers Routes find the match
Delete the star coreyai dot ai patch

[Outro]
Delete the route delete the route
Site fourteen flips no doubt
